mentions.name: ExhibitPlay
mentions.description: A games curation site focused on hyper-specific themes. Instead of broad genres, it presents curated collections that highlight the themes within genres to make game discovery more interesting. Content is manually maintained JSON data displayed in a grid, with inspiration from Letterboxd lists. Future plans include online and in-person exhibitions for smaller curation and commissioning writers and curators to add depth; it is a non-profit passion project meant as a resource and celebration.
mentions.problem: Game genres are so broad that game discovery becomes a boring process.
mentions.audience: Researchers, academics, other curators, and the game community.
mentions.source_excerpt: Been working on a games curation site that is focused on hyper specific themes (https://exhibitplay.com/). I find game genres to be so broad, which makes discovery a boring process. My idea is to take a curatorial approach and make collections that highlight the themes that exist within genres.
